title: Long-Wait Multiplier for Delayed First Certificates
content:
## SSL/TLS Certificates — long-wait multiplier schedule

For a Harborline multi-domain certificate subscription whose first certificate arrived late, the waiting days counted in the validation-wait credit are multiplied by the long-wait multiplier. The multiplier follows the number of calendar days from the order date to the issue date of the first certificate (its initial issuance).

| Calendar days from the order date to the first certificate | Long-wait multiplier on the waiting days |
|---|---|
| more than 21 | 3 (the waiting days are tripled) |
| more than 7, up to and including 21 | 2 (the waiting days are doubled) |
| 7 or fewer | the waiting days are not multiplied |

### Edges of each band

- 7 days from order to first certificate: not multiplied. 8 days: doubled.
- 21 days: doubled. 22 days: tripled.

The span that sets the band is measured in calendar days from the order date to the first certificate, and only that span decides the band.

### Hypothetical cases

Invented figures, for illustration only.

| Order date | First certificate | Days from order | Band | 4 waiting days become |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 10 May 2031 | 15 May 2031 | 5 | not multiplied | 4 |
| 10 May 2031 | 29 May 2031 | 19 | doubled | 8 |
| 10 May 2031 | 4 June 2031 | 25 | tripled | 12 |

The last column applies each band to the same hypothetical count of 4 waiting days, to show the effect of the band alone.
